> SYSmoAI is a Bangladesh-based AI systems and automation practice founded by Emon Hossain. It turns operational problems into scoped workflows, automations, and AI-assisted systems that can be tested, documented, and handed over responsibly.

## Brand
- Company: SYSmoAI
- Tagline: Systems in Motion.
- Mission: Practical AI systems and automation for real operations.
- Promise: Scope, deliverables, commercial terms, and acceptance criteria are confirmed in writing per engagement.
- Founded: 2026
- Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh
- Website: https://sysmoai.com

## Founder
- Name: Emon Hossain
- Title: Founder, AI Systems Strategist & Automation Builder
- Personal site: https://emonhossain.pro

## What SYSmoAI works on
- Workflow diagnosis — mapping current processes, bottlenecks, tools, and failure points
- Automation implementation — connecting tools and operational steps into maintainable workflows
- AI-assisted operations — applying AI where drafting, classification, extraction, or structured assistance adds value
- Internal operating systems — dashboards, SOPs, databases, and operating views for better control

## How an engagement is defined
The written proposal is the commercial source of truth: deliverables, exclusions, dependencies, milestones, timeline, payment terms, acceptance method, and support period. Pricing and timelines are confirmed only after the workflow is understood — SYSmoAI does not publish pre-priced packages or universal guarantees.

## Evidence rule
Public numerical outcomes, rankings, performance metrics, and client results are published only with a source and explicit approval. Hypothetical or illustrative scenarios are labelled as such.
